steps.title: Hear Mavuin's plea in his cell

requires.why: You have not spoken to Mavuin about his case before.

actions.detail: Find Mavuin in his prison cell in the Plane of Justice and hail him. He offers his journal and mentions information.
Say information to Mavuin to get the flag.

npcs.name: Mavuin
npcs.notes: Locked in a prison cell in the Plane of Justice. Always there.

steps.credit: Only the person who says information.
steps.message: Mavuin asks you to 'go before the tribunal and plead my case', then you see 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If hailing him gives 'Please it is the only hope that I live for...', you already have this step. Go to the Tribunal next.
If you see the flag message again, it does not mean anything changed. You already had this step.
Once the Tribunal has agreed to hear his case, Mavuin ignores the word information. You are past this step.
steps.notes: Any sentence that contains the word information works.
steps.why: Mavuin is a prisoner in the Plane of Justice who says he was framed. Agreeing to help him starts the Plane of Justice story, which later opens the portals to Valor and Storms.

steps.title: Win a Tribunal trial and loot its Mark

actions.detail: Optionally say prove to a Tribunal in the trial room. It asks if you are prepared.
Optionally say prepared. That Tribunal describes its trial. Each of the six Tribunals runs a different trial.

Say the start phrase to the matching Tribunal to begin and be moved into the trial. The example here is Lashing. For the others say 'ready to begin the Trial of Execution', Stoning, Torture, Hanging or Flame.
actions.say: ready to begin the Trial of Lashing

actions.detail: Win the trial. A boss appears at the end: Lashman Azakal (Lashing), Prime Executioner Vathoch (Execution), Yurae Zhaleem (Stoning), Punisher Veshtaq (Torture), Gallows Master Teion (Hanging) or Punisher of Flame (Flame). Kill it.
Loot that trial's Mark from the boss corpse. It always drops enough for everyone, but each player must loot their own.

npcs.name: The Tribunal (Trial of Lashing)
npcs.notes: One of six Tribunals in the trial room of the Plane of Justice. This one runs the Trial of Lashing.

npcs.name: The Tribunal (Trial of Execution)
npcs.notes: In the trial room. Runs the Trial of Execution.

npcs.name: The Tribunal (Trial of Stoning)
npcs.notes: In the trial room. Runs the Trial of Stoning.

npcs.name: The Tribunal (Trial of Torture)
npcs.notes: In the trial room. Runs the Trial of Torture.

npcs.name: The Tribunal (Trial of Hanging)
npcs.notes: In the trial room. Runs the Trial of Hanging.

npcs.name: The Tribunal (Trial of Flame)
npcs.notes: In the trial room. Runs the Trial of Flame.

steps.credit: No flag here. Each player who loots a Mark from the boss corpse has one. The Mark is what counts.
steps.message: The Tribunal says 'Then begin.' and you are moved into the trial. After the win, the Mark is in your inventory.
debug: Say the phrase with that Tribunal's own trial name. Naming another trial does nothing.
'That trial is already underway.  You must wait.' means another team is in it, or someone is still inside. Wait and try again.
Stand close to the Tribunal when the leader speaks. Only your group nearby is moved in. In a raid, only the speaker's raid group nearby goes in.
If the trial fails you see that it 'has failed' and are sent back 10 seconds later. Corpses inside are moved to the graveyard. You can retry after 1 minute.
The boss corpse decays after 8 minutes. You are sent out about 10 minutes after a win. Loot your Mark quickly.
Marks are lore. You cannot loot a second copy of a Mark you already have.
steps.notes: Each trial fails in its own way, for example if a prisoner dies. After a win the trial is locked for 10 minutes. You get a warning one minute before you are sent out. If you log in inside a trial area, you are moved out of it.
steps.why: The Tribunal will only hear Mavuin's plea from someone who has won one of its six trials. Winning a trial gives you its Mark as proof.

steps.title: Plead Mavuin's case to the Tribunal

requires.why: You have heard Mavuin's plea in his cell.
You have at least one trial Mark in your inventory, bags, bank or shared bank.

actions.detail: Carry at least one trial Mark. Say mavuin to any of the six Tribunals in the trial room.

npcs.name: The Tribunal
npcs.notes: Any of the six Tribunals in the Plane of Justice trial room.

steps.credit: Only the person who says mavuin.
steps.message: The Tribunal says 'You have completed a trial - impressive for mortals.  You can tell Mavuin that we will hear his plea.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If the Tribunal says you 'must prove yourself in one of our trials', it cannot find a Mark. Win a trial and loot your Mark.
Marks left on your corpse do not count. Get your corpse back first.
If the Tribunal says nothing at all, you have not talked to Mavuin yet. Do that first.
Hailing only gives 'What do you want, mortal?'. You must say mavuin.
'Do not worry about Mavuin...' means you already finished his story.
steps.why: With a trial won, you can ask the Tribunal to hear Mavuin's plea. This is the middle step of the Plane of Justice story.

steps.title: Tell Mavuin the Tribunal will hear him

requires.why: The Tribunal has agreed to hear Mavuin's case.

actions.detail: Go back to Mavuin's cell in the Plane of Justice and hail him.

npcs.name: Mavuin
npcs.notes: In his prison cell in the Plane of Justice.

steps.credit: Only the person who hails him.
steps.message: Mavuin thanks you and asks you to 'seek an audience with Karana and Mithaniel Marr', then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: 'Please it is the only hope that I live for...' means you still need to plead his case to the Tribunal.
The flag message shows on every hail after this point. Seeing it again does not mean a new flag.
steps.notes: Mavuin also asks you to seek from Marr a way to translate the divine language. A later step needs this one finished.
steps.why: This finishes the Plane of Justice story. It opens the Plane of Valor and Plane of Storms portals in the Plane of Tranquility.

steps.title: Show all six Marks to the Tribunal

requires.why: You hold all six trial Marks, or you already did this step before.

actions.detail: Carry all six trial Marks. Say knowledge to one of the Tribunals in the trial room. You get the flag and The Mark of Justice.

npcs.name: The Tribunal
npcs.notes: Any of the Tribunals in the Plane of Justice trial room.

steps.credit: Only the person who says knowledge.
steps.message: The Tribunal says 'Most impressive.' and 'A gleaming metal disc appears in your hand.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: 'there are more trials yet for you to complete' means you have some Marks but not all six.
'The knowledge of the gods is not so easily given to an unproven mortal.' means it found no Marks at all.
Marks count from your inventory, bags, bank and shared bank.
steps.notes: Some guides say to use the word information. The word that works is knowledge. If you lose The Mark of Justice later, say knowledge again to get a new one. This step is not needed to finish the first tier.
steps.why: An optional step. Winning all six trials earns The Mark of Justice, which lets you challenge the Seventh Hammer.

steps.title: Enter the Seventh Hammer's room (optional)

requires.why: You hold The Mark of Justice on your cursor when you click the portal.

actions.detail: Pick up The Mark of Justice so it sits on your mouse cursor. Then click one of the six trial portal doors in the Plane of Justice.
Optionally say ready to face to the Seventh Hammer to start the fight.
Kill the Seventh Hammer. This kill gives no flag.

npcs.name: The Seventh Hammer
npcs.notes: Alone in his own room, reached through a trial portal while holding The Mark of Justice. Respawns every 3 days.

steps.credit: No flag for anyone.
steps.message: You arrive in the Seventh Hammer's room. Hailing him gives 'are you ready to face judgement?'
debug: The Mark must be on your cursor. It does not work from a bag or while worn.
Only the six trial portal doors take you there.
If the Seventh Hammer is already fighting someone, you go to the normal destination instead.
steps.why: An optional fight. The Mark of Justice takes you to the Seventh Hammer. Killing it gives no flag.

steps.title: Get the ward request from Adler Fuirstel

requires.why: You have not started the Plane of Disease story yet.

actions.detail: Optionally hail Adler Fuirstel in the Plane of Tranquility.
Optionally say plane of disease for the story.
Say ward to get the flag.

npcs.name: Adler Fuirstel
npcs.notes: Standing outside in the Plane of Tranquility, not with his brother in the elders' building.

steps.credit: Only the person who says ward.
steps.message: Adler says 'If you dare travel into this pungent plane and find the ward bring it back.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: The flag message shows even if you already started this story. It only changes something the first time.
If you killed Grummus before talking to Adler, do this step now. Then use your saved memory at the Seer.
steps.why: Adler's brother Milyk is dying of a plague. Agreeing to fetch the ward starts the Plane of Disease story.

steps.title: Kill Grummus and hail the planar projection

requires.why: Adler Fuirstel has asked you to bring back the ward.

actions.detail: Kill Grummus in the Plane of Disease. A planar projection appears at his corpse.
Hail the projection within 20 minutes.

npcs.name: Grummus
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Disease. Respawns every 3 days.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.notes: Appears where Grummus died. Stays for 20 minutes.

steps.credit: Everyone in the raid of the player who earned the kill. If that player was not in a raid, their group. If they were alone, only them.
steps.message: You hear Milyk Fuirstel's voice: 'return to me with the ward that now envelops your body.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: No reply at all means you are not in the raid or group that earned the kill.
Do not leave and rejoin the raid. A rejoin can change the raid and lose your credit.
The projection gives credit only a limited number of times. Hail early.
The projection leaves 20 minutes after it appears.
steps.notes: The same hail also gives you Crypt of Decay access if you lack it. It clears any saved Grummus memory you held.
steps.why: Grummus guards the way into Bertoxxulous's home. His death gives you the ward that Milyk Fuirstel needs.

steps.title: Earn Crypt of Decay access from the Grummus kill

actions.detail: Kill Grummus in the Plane of Disease.
Hail the planar projection. Every credited player without Crypt of Decay access gets it, wherever they are in the Fuirstel story.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.notes: Appears where Grummus died. Stays for 20 minutes.

steps.credit: Everyone in the raid of the player who earned the kill. If that player was not in a raid, their group. If they were alone, only them.
steps.message: There is no message of its own. You see whatever else the projection says to you.
debug: This is given silently. If you are midway through the Fuirstel story, the projection may say nothing at all and still give it.
Ask the Seer for guided meditation. She says the entrance to the Crypt of Bertoxxulous 'should open before your might' once you have it.
There is no saved memory for this one. You must be credited for a Grummus kill and hail the projection.
steps.notes: Entering the Crypt of Decay with this step done adds the zone to your access list. It is unclear whether the server enforces Crypt of Decay entry.
steps.why: Hailing the projection after Grummus dies records that Grummus is dead. That is your access to the Crypt of Decay, home of Bertoxxulous.

steps.title: Save a memory of Grummus before meeting Adler

requires.why: You have not started the Plane of Disease story with Adler Fuirstel.
You do not already have a saved Grummus memory.

actions.detail: Be credited for a Grummus kill before you have talked to Adler Fuirstel.
Hail the planar projection to save the memory.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.notes: Appears where Grummus died.

steps.credit: Everyone in the raid of the player who earned the kill. If that player was not in a raid, their group. If they were alone, only them.
steps.message: The projection tells you to 'push it out of the way and jump into the very plague that is Bertoxxulous' home', then 'You have received a new checklist flag!'
debug: If you already talked to Adler, you get the real credit instead. Nothing to save.
steps.notes: Next, say ward to Adler Fuirstel. Then sit next to Seer Mal Nae`Shi in the Plane of Knowledge and say unlock memories.
steps.why: If you kill Grummus before Adler Fuirstel asks for the ward, the game saves a memory of it. You turn it into real credit later at the Seer.

steps.title: Unlock the Grummus memory at the Seer

requires.why: You have a saved memory of the Grummus kill.
Adler Fuirstel has asked you for the ward, and you have not gone further.

actions.detail: Sit down next to Seer Mal Nae`Shi in the Plane of Knowledge. Say unlock memories.

npcs.name: Seer Mal Nae`Shi
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Knowledge. Always there.

steps.credit: Only the person who says it.
steps.message: 'Inside you find the small ward that was lying near Grummus' body, perhaps you should bring this to Milyk.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Sit down. Standing gives 'You will never be able to focus unless you are relaxed.'
If you 'remember seeing a small trinket by Grummus' body', go say ward to Adler Fuirstel first.
'no recent events spark a memory' means you have no saved memories.
steps.notes: Any line with both words unlock and memories works.
steps.why: Turns your saved memory of the Grummus kill into real credit, as if you had the ward all along.

steps.title: Bring the ward to Elder Fuirstel

requires.why: You got the ward from the Grummus kill, or from your saved memory at the Seer.

actions.detail: Hail Elder Fuirstel (Milyk) in the elders' building in the Plane of Tranquility. No item is needed.

npcs.name: Elder Fuirstel
npcs.notes: In the elders' building in the Plane of Tranquility.

steps.credit: Only the person who hails him.
steps.message: Elder Fuirstel says 'I no longer feel the touch of death on my soul.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If he only 'groans in agony', you do not have the ward yet. Kill Grummus and hail the projection.
steps.notes: The ward is not an item. Just hail him. The next step is killing Bertoxxulous in the Crypt of Decay, which is in the second tier.
steps.why: The ward you carry saves Milyk Fuirstel from death. He then asks you to kill Bertoxxulous.

steps.title: Report Bertoxxulous' defeat to Elder Fuirstel

requires.why: You got credit for killing Bertoxxulous in the Crypt of Decay.

actions.detail: After you have credit for killing Bertoxxulous, hail Elder Fuirstel in the Plane of Tranquility.

npcs.name: Elder Fuirstel
npcs.notes: In the elders' building in the Plane of Tranquility.

steps.credit: Only the person who hails him.
steps.message: Elder Fuirstel says 'Welcome back friend.  I must tell you that my brother and I shall never forget what you have done for us.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If he repeats his text about the ward, you are missing credit for Bertoxxulous.
steps.notes: This and visiting the recovered Thelin together open the Torment portal and new talk with Fahlia Shadyglade about Tylis. It is needed to finish the first tier.
steps.why: This finishes the Plane of Disease story. Together with Thelin's story, it opens the portal to Torment, the Plane of Pain.

steps.title: Learn of Thelin's coma from Adroha Jezith

requires.why: You have not started Thelin's story yet.

actions.detail: Optionally hail Adroha Jezith in the elders' building in the Plane of Tranquility.
Optionally say coma to hear the story.
Say tortured by nightmares to get the flag.

npcs.name: Adroha Jezith
npcs.notes: In the elders' building in the Plane of Tranquility, next to the sleeping Thelin.

steps.credit: Only the person who says it.
steps.message: Adroha says 'Try to find his planar projection in Terris' plane. Help him wake from this torment.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If she only answers hail with 'This is wonderful! Thelin is starting to recover slowly...', you are already far past this step.
Hailing Thelin himself only makes Adroha sigh about his coma. Talk to Adroha.
steps.notes: The middle words (poverty and ruin, jeweled dagger, Plane of Tranquility) are optional.
steps.why: Thelin Poxbourne is trapped in a nightmare by Terris Thule. Listening to Adroha starts the Plane of Nightmare story.

steps.title: Enter Thelin's hedge maze

requires.why: The person saying ready has heard Adroha Jezith's story. People taken in with them do not need it.

actions.detail: Hail the sleeping Thelin Poxbourne outside the maze in the Plane of Nightmare.
Optionally say dagger.
Optionally say help.
Each group leader says ready. Thelin takes the group into one of three dream mazes.

npcs.name: Thelin Poxbourne
npcs.notes: Asleep outside the hedge maze in the Plane of Nightmare.

steps.credit: The speaker's group members nearby go in. In a raid, the speaker's raid group nearby. Raid members not in a group go alone.
steps.message: 'Thelin Poxbourne closes his eyes and falls asleep immediately.' and your group is moved into the maze.
debug: If he 'screams loudly, and then falls asleep once again', the speaker has not talked to Adroha Jezith.
'I suddenly feel the grasp of Terris upon my heart' means all three mazes are busy, or your raid's maze is full. A maze holds 24 players.
Stand close to the leader when they say ready.
Inside, someone must tell Thelin ready within 5 minutes. Otherwise Terris throws you out.
steps.notes: A raid fills its own maze first. Groups not in a raid can share a free maze that has not started. Players beyond 24 are moved out. Inside, hail Thelin and say ready. He walks the maze, picking up pieces of a dagger, while monsters attack. If he dies, the maze fails and everyone is removed.
steps.why: Thelin's dream is a hedge maze in the Plane of Nightmare. Your group must go in and protect him to free him.

steps.title: Complete the hedge maze and hail Thelin

requires.why: You have heard Adroha Jezith's story about Thelin's coma.

actions.detail: Inside the maze, tell Thelin ready to start his walk.
Protect Thelin through the waves of monsters. At the end a construct of nightmares appears. Kill it.
Loot the Dagger Blade Shard from the construct. It always drops.
Hand the shard to Thelin. You get Thelin's Dagger, Terris Thule appears and they talk.
When Terris vanishes and Thelin finishes speaking, every player hails Thelin.

npcs.name: Thelin Poxbourne
npcs.notes: Inside the dream maze. Each of the three mazes has its own Thelin.

npcs.name: A construct of nightmares
npcs.notes: Appears where Thelin's walk ends.

npcs.name: Terris Thule
npcs.notes: Appears after the shard is handed in. Only talks.

steps.credit: Each player who hails Thelin at the end. There is no group or raid check.
steps.message: Thelin says 'Please destroy her for all that have had to endure her hideous visions.' and casts Waking Moment on you, then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Thelin only takes the shard after he has finished his walk. Otherwise he gives it back.
Hail only after the talking ends, about 20 seconds after his walk. You then have 10 minutes before 'The nightmare fades from around you.'
If you never talked to Adroha, you get a saved memory instead. See the maze memory step.
If Thelin dies, the maze fails. Corpses go to the graveyard and everyone is removed.
If you already had this step, you see the text but no flag message.
steps.notes: This clears any saved maze memory you held. If nobody hands in the shard, the maze clears itself after 2 hours.
steps.why: Guiding Thelin through his dream breaks Terris Thule's hold. It lets you enter the Lair of Terris Thule.

steps.title: Save a memory of the maze before meeting Adroha

requires.why: You have not talked to Adroha Jezith about Thelin yet.

actions.detail: Be taken into the maze by a group or raid-group leader who has talked to Adroha.
When the maze is complete, hail Thelin inside the maze.

npcs.name: Thelin Poxbourne
npcs.notes: Inside the dream maze.

steps.credit: Each player who hails Thelin at the end.
steps.message: Thelin says 'I do not recognize your face. Are you a vision sent by Terris?!' then 'You have received a new checklist flag!'
debug: Hail only after the talking ends, during the 10 minutes before the dream fades.
steps.notes: Next, say tortured by nightmares to Adroha Jezith. Then sit next to Seer Mal Nae`Shi in the Plane of Knowledge and say unlock memories. Hailing again just saves the same memory.
steps.why: If you finish the maze before Adroha Jezith tells you about Thelin, the game saves a memory of it. You turn it into real credit later at the Seer.

steps.title: Unlock the hedge maze memory at the Seer

requires.why: You have a saved memory of the hedge maze.
Adroha Jezith has told you about Thelin, and you have not gone further.

actions.detail: Sit down next to Seer Mal Nae`Shi in the Plane of Knowledge. Say unlock memories.

npcs.name: Seer Mal Nae`Shi
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Knowledge. Always there.

steps.credit: Only the person who says it.
steps.message: Thelin speaks in your mind: 'It was an act of kindness to help me in the maze before you knew I was in need of help.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: A blank line and no change means you have not talked to Adroha Jezith yet.
Sit down before you speak.
steps.notes: If you also have a saved Terris Thule memory, one request unlocks both, maze first.
steps.why: Turns your saved memory of the maze into real credit. You can then enter the Lair of Terris Thule.

steps.title: Kill Terris Thule and hail the planar projection

requires.why: You have completed Thelin's hedge maze.

actions.detail: Click the portal in the Plane of Nightmare to enter the Lair of Terris Thule.
Kill Terris Thule.
Hail the planar projection within 20 minutes.

npcs.name: Terris Thule
npcs.notes: In the Lair of Terris Thule. Respawns every 3 days.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.notes: Appears where Terris Thule died. Stays for 20 minutes.

steps.credit: Everyone in the raid of the player who earned the kill. If that player was not in a raid, their group. If they were alone, only them.
steps.message: Thelin's voice says 'The cruel hand of Terris no longer shall torment my dreams.' and asks you to return to the Plane of Tranquility, then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: 'You lack the will to pass through this portal safely.' at the portal means you have not completed the maze.
No reply means you are not in the raid or group that earned the kill, or the projection has used up its credit. It gives credit to about 72 players.
If you never talked to Adroha, you get a saved memory instead.
If you already have this step, the projection says nothing.
steps.notes: This clears any saved Terris Thule memory.
steps.why: Killing Terris Thule frees Thelin from his nightmare for good.

steps.title: Save a memory of Terris Thule before the maze

requires.why: You have not completed the hedge maze. You may or may not have talked to Adroha Jezith.
You do not already have a saved Terris Thule memory.

actions.detail: Be in the raid or group that earned the Terris Thule kill.
Hail the planar projection.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.notes: Appears where Terris Thule died.

steps.credit: Everyone in the raid of the player who earned the kill. If that player was not in a raid, their group. If they were alone, only them.
steps.message: No words from the projection. You only see 'You have received a new checklist flag!'
debug: You normally need the maze done to enter the lair at all. This mostly helps players who could already get in.
steps.notes: Unlock it at the Seer after you have completed the maze.
steps.why: If you are credited for Terris Thule before you finished the maze, the game saves a memory of it. You turn it into real credit later at the Seer.

steps.title: Unlock the Terris Thule memory at the Seer

requires.why: You have a saved memory of the Terris Thule kill.
You have completed the hedge maze, and you have not gone further.

actions.detail: Sit down next to Seer Mal Nae`Shi in the Plane of Knowledge. Say unlock memories.

npcs.name: Seer Mal Nae`Shi
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Knowledge. Always there.

steps.credit: Only the person who says it.
steps.message: You 'strike Terris down with Thelin's dagger' in a vision, and Thelin says 'Finally, you have freed me from nightmare.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: 'Terris still haunts your nightmares whenever you attemt to recall your battle with her.' means you must complete the maze first.
Sit down before you speak.
steps.why: Turns your saved memory of the Terris Thule kill into real credit.

steps.title: Visit the recovering Thelin

requires.why: You have killed Terris Thule and hailed her projection, or unlocked that memory at the Seer.

actions.detail: Hail Thelin (Elder Poxbourne) in the elders' building in the Plane of Tranquility.

npcs.name: Elder Poxbourne (Thelin)
npcs.notes: Lying in the elders' building in the Plane of Tranquility.

steps.credit: Only the person who hails him.
steps.message: Thelin says 'I want you to know how much I appreciate your bravery in helping me.' then 'You receive a character flag!'
debug: If Adroha sighs about his coma and 'Thelin tosses and turns violently on the floor', you do not have the Terris Thule credit yet.
steps.notes: The success line here reads 'You receive a character flag!', not 'You have received'. Needed to finish the first tier.
steps.why: This finishes the Plane of Nightmare story. Together with the Fuirstel story, it opens the portal to Torment, the Plane of Pain.

steps.title: Agree to test the machine for Giwin Mirakon

requires.why: You have not talked to Giwin about the machine before.

actions.detail: Optionally hail Giwin Mirakon in the Plane of Innovation.
Optionally say great warrior.
Optionally say task.
Say test the machine to get the flag.

npcs.name: Giwin Mirakon
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Innovation. A different Giwin stands in the Plane of Tactics.

steps.credit: Only the person who says it.
steps.message: Giwin says 'Haha!  I knew I sensed the warring spirit within you.' and 'Long live Rallos!' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If every answer is 'Well go on then, what are you cowering around for...', you already have this step.
steps.notes: You can do this before or after the Behemoth kill. If after, use your saved memory at the Seer.
steps.why: Giwin, a follower of Rallos Zek, wants you to destroy the Manaetic Behemoth. This starts the Plane of Innovation story that leads to the Plane of Tactics.

steps.title: Power Nitram's machine, kill Xanamech, hail Nitram

actions.detail: Optionally talk to Nitram Anizok to learn which parts he needs. Say hail, then advanced tinkering, construction, instinct for survival, combination of batteries and collecting materials.
Loot a Copper Node, a Bundle of Super Conductive Wires and an Intact Power Cell from clockworks in the Plane of Innovation. Each is a rare drop.
Hand all three to Nitram in one trade. He walks off.
Follow him. Xanamech Nezmirthafen appears along his walk and wakes as Nitram goes on. Kill it.
Each credited player hails Nitram within 10 minutes of the kill.

npcs.name: Nitram Anizok
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Innovation.

npcs.name: Xanamech Nezmirthafen
npcs.notes: Appears along Nitram's walk after the hand-in. Leaves after 30 minutes out of combat.

steps.credit: Everyone in the raid of the player who earned the Xanamech kill. If that player was not in a raid, their group. If they were alone, only them.
steps.message: Nitram says 'Whew that was a close one!' and tells you to 'twist the very bottom rivet of the icon three times to the right', then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Hand in exactly the three parts in one trade. Anything else is given back. He also refuses while already walking.
If Xanamech is not up when Nitram reaches it, Nitram disappears.
After the kill, Nitram only answers hail, and only to the raid or group that earned the kill.
Nitram leaves 10 minutes after Xanamech dies. Hail quickly.
Nitram gives credit to about 72 players. If you already had it, you see the text but no flag message.
steps.notes: With this step done, clicking the main factory door opens it. If the event stalls, Nitram leaves 1 hour after the hand-in.
steps.why: Saving Nitram from Xanamech earns the trick to open the main factory door. The Manaetic Behemoth is behind it.

steps.title: Kill the Manaetic Behemoth and report to Giwin

requires.why: Giwin Mirakon has asked you to test the machine.
You have saved Nitram from Xanamech, so the factory door opens for you. This is inferred from where the Behemoth stands.

actions.detail: Inside the factory, clockwork devices appear every 48 seconds from six spots and walk to the Behemoth. Kill 10 of them to wake it.
Kill the Manaetic Behemoth inside its room.
Hail the Giwin Mirakon who appears, within 10 minutes.

npcs.name: Manaetic Behemoth
npcs.notes: In its room inside the Plane of Innovation factory. Respawns every 3 days.

npcs.name: Giwin Mirakon
npcs.notes: Appears near the Behemoth's room when it dies. Leaves after 10 minutes.

npcs.name: Weapon Event Master
npcs.notes: An unseen helper in the Behemoth's area that runs the waves of devices.

steps.credit: Everyone in the raid of the player who earned the Behemoth kill. If that player was not in a raid, their group. If they were alone, only them.
steps.message: Giwin says 'You destroyed the machine?!' and 'I anticipate our next meeting on the Battlefields of Zek!' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Only devices you kill count. Devices that reach the Behemoth explode and do not count.
Do not pull the Behemoth out of its room. It runs back, heals fully and forgets the fight.
If it is not killed within 3 hours of waking, not counting time in combat, it leaves and tries again 10 minutes later.
If Giwin says 'Hey what are you doing!', you had not talked to the first Giwin. You get a saved memory instead.
Giwin gives credit to about 72 players. If you already had it, you see the text but no flag message.
steps.notes: This clears any saved Behemoth memory. Later steps of this story happen in the Plane of Tactics.
steps.why: Destroying the Behemoth finishes the Plane of Innovation story. It opens the Plane of Tactics portal in the Plane of Tranquility.

steps.title: Save a memory of the Behemoth before meeting Giwin

requires.why: You have not talked to Giwin about testing the machine.
You do not already have a saved Behemoth memory.

actions.detail: Be in the raid or group that earned the Manaetic Behemoth kill.
Hail the Giwin Mirakon who appears.

npcs.name: Giwin Mirakon
npcs.notes: Appears near the Behemoth's room when it dies.

steps.credit: Everyone in the raid of the player who earned the kill. If that player was not in a raid, their group. If they were alone, only them.
steps.message: Giwin says 'Hey what are you doing!  Look at this mess that you have caused.' then 'You have received a new checklist flag!'
debug: Giwin gives credit to about 72 players. Hail early.
steps.notes: Next, say test the machine to the Giwin in the Plane of Innovation. Then sit next to Seer Mal Nae`Shi in the Plane of Knowledge and say unlock memories.
steps.why: If you kill the Behemoth before Giwin asks you to test the machine, the game saves a memory of it. You turn it into real credit later at the Seer.

steps.title: Unlock the Behemoth memory at the Seer

requires.why: You have a saved memory of the Behemoth kill.
Giwin Mirakon has asked you to test the machine, and you have not gone further.

actions.detail: Sit down next to Seer Mal Nae`Shi in the Plane of Knowledge. Say unlock memories.

npcs.name: Seer Mal Nae`Shi
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Knowledge. Always there.

steps.credit: Only the person who says it.
steps.message: Giwin's image says 'Sorry for the misunderstanding, I forgot that I asked you to test the machine for me.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: A blank line and no change means you have not told Giwin you will test the machine.
Sit down before you speak.
steps.why: Turns your saved memory of the Behemoth kill into real credit. This opens the way to the Plane of Tactics.

steps.title: Use the tier 2 portals in the Plane of Tranquility

actions.detail: Click a portal in the Plane of Tranquility. Valor and Storms need Mavuin's story finished. Torment needs both the Fuirstel and Thelin stories finished. Tactics needs the Behemoth step done.

steps.credit: Each player clicking the portal, based on their own flags.
steps.message: You travel to the new zone. If not, you see 'You lack the will to pass through this portal safely.'
debug: Check which story the portal needs and finish its last step.
steps.notes: The first tier counts as complete when you have finished Mavuin's, the Fuirstel and Thelin stories, saved Nitram, and killed the Behemoth. Alternate key-ring access exists only if the server has turned it on.
steps.why: Finishing the first tier stories opens new portals in the Plane of Tranquility. This shows which story opens which portal.

steps.title: Unlock the Valor and Storms portals

requires.why: You have finished Mavuin's case from the Plane of Justice.

actions.detail: In the Plane of Tranquility, click the Plane of Valor portal or the Plane of Storms portal.

steps.credit: Only the person who clicks. Clicking either portal unlocks both Valor and Storms for you.
steps.message: There is no message. The portal simply takes you into the zone.
debug: If you see 'You lack the will to pass through this portal safely.' you have not finished Mavuin's case yet.
Finish Mavuin's case, then click the portal again.
steps.why: These two portals in the Plane of Tranquility lead to the Plane of Valor and the Plane of Storms. Both open once you have finished Mavuin's case.

steps.title: Kill Aerin`Dar and hail the Planar Projection

requires.why: You have finished Mavuin's case, so the Plane of Valor portal lets you in.
You have finished Mavuin's case, which taught you the meaning of Justice. The projection only answers if you have.
You have not already earned credit for Aerin`Dar.

actions.detail: Kill Aerin`Dar in her lair in the Plane of Valor. Extra monsters wake as her health drops to 85, 65, 45 and 25 percent.
Hail the Planar Projection that appears at her lair after she dies.

npcs.name: Aerin`Dar
npcs.notes: In her lair in the Plane of Valor. She returns three days after she dies. The dragon orb teleporter in the zone only works while she is alive.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.notes: Appears at Aerin`Dar's lair when she dies. It leaves after 20 minutes.

steps.credit: The raid of the player who got the kill. If there is no raid, that player's group, or just that player. Up to 72 people per projection.
steps.message: 'The Planar Projection's thoughts enter your own. You have done well. You will now be able to enter the Halls of Honor.' This one does not show a 'character flag' line.
debug: Make sure you were in the raid or group of the player who got the kill.
Make sure you have finished Mavuin's case.
If you already have Aerin`Dar credit, the projection stays silent.
The projection stops answering after 72 people or after 20 minutes.
steps.notes: Since no flag message shows, check with #popflags 2. Look for 'Aerin`Dar defeated; the meaning of Justice remains'. There is no saved memory for this kill. If you somehow kill her without Mavuin's case done, you must kill her again.
steps.why: Killing the dragon Aerin`Dar in the Plane of Valor is the first half of earning entry to the Halls of Honor.

steps.title: Step through the Halls of Honor portal

requires.why: You have finished Mavuin's case, so the Plane of Valor portal lets you in.
You have hailed the Planar Projection after Aerin`Dar died.

actions.detail: In the Plane of Valor, click the Halls of Honor teleporter.

steps.credit: Only the person who clicks.
steps.message: 'You have received a character flag!' and the portal takes you into the Halls of Honor.
debug: If you see 'You lack the will to pass through this portal safely.' you have no Aerin`Dar credit. Kill her and hail the projection.
If you already got this step another way, such as from the Seer, the click may not give you permission to enter the Halls of Honor.
steps.notes: The same click also clears any saved Aerin`Dar memory.
steps.why: Clicking this portal records your Aerin`Dar victory and gives you permission to enter the Halls of Honor.

steps.title: Turn your saved Aerin`Dar memory into credit

requires.why: You have a saved memory of killing Aerin`Dar.
You have finished Mavuin's case.

actions.detail: Go to Seer Mal Nae`Shi in the Plane of Knowledge. Sit down next to her and say a sentence with both 'unlock' and 'memories'.

npcs.name: Seer Mal Nae`Shi
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Knowledge.

steps.credit: Only the person who speaks.
steps.message: 'You have learned the meaning of both Justice and Honor. You may now pass into the Halls of Honor.' Then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Make sure you are sitting down. Standing gives 'You will never be able to focus unless you are relaxed...'
If the Seer says 'You have defeated Aerin`Dar but have yet to learn the true meaning of Justice.' finish Mavuin's case first.
steps.notes: No quest actually saves an Aerin`Dar memory, so you should never need this. The Seer does not give permission to enter the Halls of Honor. The Valor portal may not either after this.
steps.why: A safety net: if the game saved a memory of your Aerin`Dar kill, the Seer can turn it into real credit.

steps.title: Show Askr a storm giant head and get his Bag of Verity

requires.why: You have finished Mavuin's case, so the Plane of Storms portal lets you in.
You have not yet handed Askr the Sealed Bag of Verity.

actions.detail: Kill storm giants in the Plane of Storms and loot a Storm Giant Head. Any of the three kinds works.
Hand Askr the Lost one Storm Giant Head. He gives you back a useless head.
Say 'it was me' to Askr. Saying 'yes' also works.
Say 'paying attention' to Askr. Saying 'yes' also works.
Say 'continue' to Askr.
Say 'continue' again. Askr puts his Bag of Verity on your cursor.

npcs.name: Askr the Lost
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Storms.

steps.credit: Only the person who trades and talks with Askr.
steps.message: Askr says '... When you have acquired the three of these items, seal them in this bag and return them to me...' and the bag appears on your cursor.
debug: Do not leave the zone during the talk. Askr forgets you about 15 seconds after you leave, and you must hand in a head again.
If Askr says 'You did well defeating one giant...' you already have the bag.
If you already handed in the Sealed Bag of Verity, none of this talk happens.
steps.notes: Heads drop from the Srerendi, Krendic and Kelek`Vor giants. If you come back later, hailing Askr may skip ahead to the 'continue' part ('I was afraid you would not return...'). The head gives a tiny bit of experience.
steps.why: Askr the Lost in the Plane of Storms starts your road to the Bastion of Thunder. Proving you killed a storm giant earns his bag.

steps.title: Hand Askr the Sealed Bag of Verity

requires.why: You have finished Mavuin's case, so the Plane of Storms portal lets you in.
You have not already handed Askr the Sealed Bag of Verity.

actions.detail: Loot a beard from Srerendi giants, a bone from Krendic giants and a sash from Kelek`Vor giants.
Put the three items in Askr's Bag of Verity and press Combine. This makes Askr's Sealed Bag of Verity.
Hand the sealed bag to Askr the Lost.

npcs.name: Askr the Lost
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Storms.

steps.credit: Only the person who hands in the bag.
steps.message: Askr looks over the remnants and says 'Then it's true! ...' Then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If you already have this flag, Askr says nothing and gives no reward.
Wrong items are handed back to you. Check that you gave the sealed bag.
steps.notes: You also get some experience. Beards drop from a fannsk, an her megir, a hleytis maor and a hleyta menn. Bones drop from a jotna giants. Sashes drop from an irmin giants.
steps.why: Bringing Askr proof from all three giant tribes earns your first Plane of Storms flag.

steps.title: Get a new bag from Askr and make the Esoteric Meld

requires.why: You have finished Mavuin's case, so the Plane of Storms portal lets you in.
You have handed Askr the Sealed Bag of Verity.

actions.detail: Say 'bastion of thunder' to Askr the Lost. He gives you another Bag of Verity.
Loot two Esoteric Medallions from two different tribes. They come from the tribe lords, their minibosses or their event giants.
Put the two different medallions in the bag and press Combine. This makes the Esoteric Meld.

npcs.name: Askr the Lost
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Storms.

npcs.name: Jeplak, Lord of Srerendi
npcs.notes: Lord of the Srerendi giants. Drops the Srerendi medallion.

npcs.name: Gurebk, Lord of Krendic
npcs.notes: Lord of the Krendic giants. Drops the Krendic medallion.

npcs.name: Neffiken, Lord of Kelek`Vor
npcs.notes: Lord of the Kelek`Vor giants. Drops the Kelek`Vor medallion.

npcs.name: Paruek the Strong
npcs.notes: Srerendi miniboss. Carries Srerendi medallions.

npcs.name: Faruek the Bold
npcs.notes: Srerendi miniboss. Carries Srerendi medallions.

npcs.name: Pendubk the Turbulent
npcs.notes: Krendic miniboss. Carries Krendic medallions.

npcs.name: Solnebk the Unruly
npcs.notes: Krendic miniboss. Carries Krendic medallions.

npcs.name: Laruken the Rigid
npcs.notes: Kelek`Vor miniboss. Carries Kelek`Vor medallions.

npcs.name: Zertuken the Unyielding
npcs.notes: Kelek`Vor miniboss. Carries Kelek`Vor medallions.

steps.credit: The person who talks to Askr gets the bag. Medallions are normal loot.
steps.message: Askr says 'To be honest, I cannot say that it is entirely possible... If you can find and seal two pieces of the medallion in this bag, I will be able to forge them into the medallion...'
debug: Askr only answers 'bastion of thunder' after the sealed bag and before the Meld.
Two medallions from the same tribe will not combine. You need two different tribes.
steps.notes: Each miniboss carries one to three medallions of its tribe (one to two in the guild instance). Tribe event giants have a 20 percent chance to carry one (2 percent in the guild instance).
steps.why: Askr can forge a medallion that lets you into the Bastion of Thunder. He needs two medallion pieces from different giant tribes.

steps.title: Hand Askr the Esoteric Meld

requires.why: You have finished Mavuin's case, so the Plane of Storms portal lets you in.
You have handed Askr the Sealed Bag of Verity.

actions.detail: Hand the Esoteric Meld to Askr the Lost.

npcs.name: Askr the Lost
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Storms.

steps.credit: Only the person who hands in the Meld.
steps.message: 'The mystical medallion given to you by Askr settles around your neck and then disappears into nothingness...' Askr says 'You have retrieved the pieces! ...' Then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If Askr 'merely glances at you with a questioning look' you are not at this stage. The Meld comes back on your cursor.
Hand in the Sealed Bag of Verity first if you have not.
steps.notes: You also get a good amount of experience. Afterwards, hailing Askr says 'You already have the way to the Bastion of Thunder...'.
steps.why: Askr forges the medallion into your soul. This is what lets you into the Bastion of Thunder.

steps.title: Use the Storms shrine to enter Bastion of Thunder

requires.why: You have finished Mavuin's case, so the Plane of Storms portal lets you in.
You have handed Askr the Esoteric Meld.
You have finished Mavuin's case. The shrine checks this too.

actions.detail: Go deep into Mount Grenidor in the Plane of Storms and click the shrine.

steps.credit: Only the person who clicks.
steps.message: 'An aura of soft light gleams around you as the shrine reacts to your Talisman of Thunderous Foyer and sends you forth into the mighty Bastion of Thunder.' Then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If the shrine 'finds none' and says 'you may not pass forth unto this planar location' you are missing the Meld hand-in or Mavuin's case.
If you already did this step, the shrine just moves you with no new flag.
steps.notes: The same click gives you permission to enter the Bastion of Thunder. Afterwards the Bastion of Thunder portal in the Plane of Tranquility works for you too.
steps.why: The shrine reads Askr's medallion in your soul and sends you to the Bastion of Thunder. This also unlocks it for good.

steps.title: Enter the Crypt of Decay from the Plane of Disease

requires.why: You have earned the Grummus flag in the Plane of Disease.

actions.detail: After your Grummus flag, take the zone line from the Plane of Disease into the Crypt of Decay once.

steps.credit: Only the person who zones in.
steps.message: There is no message. You simply arrive in the Crypt of Decay.
debug: The Crypt of Decay portal in the Plane of Tranquility will not take you until you do this. It says 'You lack the will to pass through this portal safely.'
Make sure you have the Grummus flag before you walk in from the Plane of Disease.
steps.notes: The Bangle of Disease Warding on your keyring can also open the Tranquility portal.
steps.why: Walking into the Crypt of Decay once from the Plane of Disease gives you permission to enter it. You need this for the Bertoxxulous steps.

steps.title: Clear the upper crypt and hail Tarkil Adan

requires.why: You have earned the Grummus flag in the Plane of Disease.
You do not already have the bone key from Tarkil Adan.

actions.detail: Engage Carprin Deatharn. Kill his three lieutenants, Breddan Rutyl, Fran Prisoal and Abroan Drian, to drop his shield.
Kill the attackable Carprin Deatharn that appears when the last lieutenant dies.
Kill Avhi Escron.
Kill Bishop Toluwon.
Kill both generals, Raex Pwodill and Vindor Mawnil. The High Priest can be attacked once the second one dies.
Kill High Priest Ultor Szanvon.
Hail Tarkil Adan, who appears after the High Priest dies.

npcs.name: Carprin Deatharn
npcs.notes: Starts the event in the upper Crypt of Decay. Shielded until his three lieutenants die. Returns three days after the event.

npcs.name: Carprin Deatharn
npcs.notes: Appears where the last lieutenant dies. This one can be killed.

npcs.name: Avhi Escron
npcs.notes: Appears during the event.

npcs.name: Bishop Toluwon
npcs.notes: Appears during the event.

npcs.name: High Priest Ultor Szanvon
npcs.notes: Appears during the event. Can be attacked once both generals are dead.

npcs.name: Vindor Mawnil
npcs.notes: A general who appears during the event and walks a set path.

npcs.name: Raex Pwodill
npcs.notes: A general who appears during the event and walks a set path.

npcs.name: Tarkil Adan
npcs.notes: Appears when the High Priest dies. Leaves after 10 minutes.

steps.credit: The raid of the player who killed the High Priest. If there is no raid, that player's group, or just that player. Up to 72 people.
steps.message: Tarkil Adan groans and passes you a small glowing bone fragment etched in runes. 'Go to the bone throne at the ruins entrance there you will find access to the depths.' Then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Make sure you were in the raid or group of the player who killed the High Priest.
If you already have the key, Tarkil stays silent.
Tarkil stops answering after 72 people or after 10 minutes.
steps.notes: Event monsters leave if nobody fights them. Lieutenants leave after about 13 minutes, generals after 165 minutes, the rest after 195 minutes. Tarkil is the only way to get the key.
steps.why: Beating the upper Crypt of Decay event earns a rune-etched bone from Tarkil Adan. It is the key to the lower crypt where Bertoxxulous waits.

steps.title: Use the bone throne to reach the lower crypt

requires.why: You have earned the Grummus flag in the Plane of Disease.
You have the bone key from Tarkil Adan.

actions.detail: In the Crypt of Decay, click the bone throne at the ruins entrance.

steps.credit: Only the person who clicks.
steps.message: You are moved down into the lower crypt.
debug: If you see 'You lack the key required to enter the lower crypt. Seek Tarkil Adan after defeating Carprin Deatharn.' you need the key first.
steps.notes: Charmed pets break free when you use the throne. Monsters chasing you also forget you.
steps.why: The bone throne at the ruins entrance takes key holders down to the lower crypt, where Bertoxxulous is fought.

steps.title: Kill Bertoxxulous and hail the Planar Projection

requires.why: You have earned the Grummus flag in the Plane of Disease.
You have the bone key from Tarkil Adan.
You have spoken with Elder Fuirstel in the Plane of Tranquility after killing Grummus.

actions.detail: Kill the Spectre of Corruption in the lower crypt to start the event. Monsters start coming about 5 minutes 50 seconds later.
Kill the Knights, Priests and Necromancers of Decay. Every few kills a King of Lxanvom appears. After 8 kings, four more kings appear: Meedo, Qezzin, Pzo and Bhaly.
After the 12th king dies, Bertoxxulous appears. Kill him.
Hail the Planar Projection that appears where Bertoxxulous died.

npcs.name: Spectre of Corruption
npcs.notes: In the lower crypt. Returns about 66 hours after a win, or 5 minutes after a failed event.

npcs.name: Bertoxxulous
npcs.notes: Appears after the 12th king dies. He moves around the room.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.notes: Appears where Bertoxxulous dies. Leaves after 20 minutes.

steps.credit: The raid of the player who got the kill. If there is no raid, that player's group, or just that player. Up to 72 people.
steps.message: 'Milyk Fuirstel's thoughts enter into your own. Bertoxxulous is slain, for this my brother and I are forever in your debt...' Then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Make sure you have the bone key. Without it the projection stays silent.
Make sure you were in the raid or group of the player who got the kill.
The projection stops answering after 72 people or after 20 minutes.
If you had not yet spoken to Elder Fuirstel, you get a saved memory instead. If you are already past this step, it stays silent.
steps.notes: The event fails 123 minutes after the Spectre dies. You hear 'Harsh laughter echoes around the crypt...' and all monsters vanish. This step also clears any saved Bertoxxulous memory.
steps.why: Slaying Bertoxxulous, god of disease, avenges the Fuirstel brothers. It is the main step of the Plane of Disease story.

steps.title: Get a saved Bertoxxulous memory

requires.why: You have earned the Grummus flag in the Plane of Disease.
You have the bone key from Tarkil Adan.
You have not yet spoken with Elder Fuirstel after killing Grummus.
You do not already have a saved Bertoxxulous memory.

actions.detail: Hail the Planar Projection after Bertoxxulous dies, the same as the main step.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.notes: Appears where Bertoxxulous dies. Leaves after 20 minutes.

steps.credit: Same as the main Bertoxxulous step. The killer's raid, group or the killer alone.
steps.message: 'The Planar Projection seems to flicker in and out of existence. It seems joyous that Bertoxxulous has been slain.' Then 'You have received a new checklist flag!'
debug: The same raid or group, 72-person and 20-minute limits apply as in the main step.
steps.notes: Later, talk to Elder Fuirstel in the Plane of Tranquility. Then sit by the Seer in the Plane of Knowledge and say 'unlock memories'.
steps.why: A safety net: if you kill Bertoxxulous before talking to Elder Fuirstel, the game saves a memory of the kill. You turn it into credit later at the Seer.

steps.title: Turn your saved Bertoxxulous memory into credit

requires.why: You have a saved memory of killing Bertoxxulous.
You have spoken with Elder Fuirstel in the Plane of Tranquility after killing Grummus.

actions.detail: Go to Seer Mal Nae`Shi in the Plane of Knowledge. Sit down next to her and say a sentence with both 'unlock' and 'memories'.

npcs.name: Seer Mal Nae`Shi
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Knowledge.

steps.credit: Only the person who speaks.
steps.message: 'You focus back to your battle with the Plaguebringer... You now have the knowledge to help Milyk.' Then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Make sure you are sitting down.
If you see 'an image of the Fuirstel brothers flashes through your mind' you are not at the right stage. Speak to Elder Fuirstel first. Your memory is kept.
steps.notes: The Seer uses up the saved memory when it works.
steps.why: If the game saved your Bertoxxulous kill, the Seer turns it into real credit once you have spoken with Elder Fuirstel.

steps.title: Unlock the Plane of Torment portal

requires.why: You have finished the Plane of Disease story with the Fuirstel brothers.
You have freed Thelin from his nightmare.

actions.detail: In the Plane of Tranquility, click the Plane of Torment portal.

steps.credit: Only the person who clicks. This gives you permission to enter Torment.
steps.message: There is no message. The portal takes you to the Plane of Torment.
debug: If you see 'You lack the will to pass through this portal safely.' one of the two stories is not finished.
steps.notes: On some servers, holding the Symbol of Torment also opens the portal, but only if alternate access is turned on.
steps.why: The Torment portal in the Plane of Tranquility opens once you have finished both the Disease and the Nightmare stories.

steps.title: Agree to help Fahlia Shadyglade free Tylis

requires.why: You have finished the Plane of Disease story, so the Torment portal lets you in.
You have freed Thelin, so the Torment portal lets you in.
You have freed Thelin from his nightmare. Fahlia checks this.
You have finished the Plane of Disease story. Fahlia checks this too.
You have not already agreed to help Fahlia.

actions.detail: Talk to Fahlia Shadyglade in the Plane of Tranquility. Say 'condition'.
Say 'black cube'.
Say 'plane of torment'.
Say 'will go', for example 'I will go'.

npcs.name: Fahlia Shadyglade
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Tranquility.

steps.credit: Only the person who speaks.
steps.message: Fahlia tells you 'Wonderful. ... You must find Maareq and do what you must to release Tylis from this torture.' Then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: If she sends you to Adler Fuirstel, finish the Plane of Disease story first.
If she says 'I can see that you may be passionate to help others...' you are missing both stories.
steps.notes: Only 'will go' counts. The other phrases are just story. If you already agreed, she still shows the flag message but nothing changes.
steps.why: Fahlia asks you to free her friend Tylis, who is trapped in the Plane of Torment. Agreeing starts the Torment story.

steps.title: Kill Maareq and have Tylis send you to the Keeper

requires.why: You have finished the Plane of Disease story, so the Torment portal lets you in.
You have freed Thelin, so the Torment portal lets you in.
You have agreed to help Fahlia Shadyglade free Tylis.

actions.detail: Kill Maareq the Prophet in the Plane of Torment. Tylis, in the cage, can then be targeted.
Optional: say 'will assist you' to Tylis Newleaf.
Say 'we are ready' or 'i am ready' to Tylis. Tylis casts Insanity of Tylis on you and moves you elsewhere in Torment.

npcs.name: Maareq the Prophet
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Torment. Returns three days after he dies.

npcs.name: Tylis Newleaf
npcs.notes: In a cage near Maareq. Can only be targeted after Maareq dies.

steps.credit: Each player must say the phrase themselves. Only the speaker is teleported.
steps.message: Tylis says 'Please tell me when you are ready...' and you are teleported.
debug: Someone must carry A Screaming Sphere in inventory or on the keyring: you or a raid or group member. Otherwise Tylis says 'The Screaming Sphere carries an echo of this place. Bring one near...'
If Tylis says 'Please seek out my companion Fahlia...' you have not agreed to help Fahlia yet.
steps.notes: Where A Screaming Sphere comes from is not known to this guide. The exact landing spot of the teleport is not confirmed.
steps.why: With Maareq dead, the caged Tylis can send you into the hidden part of Torment where the Keeper of Sorrows waits.

steps.title: Kill the Keeper of Sorrows and hail the freed Tylis

requires.why: You have finished the Plane of Disease story, so the Torment portal lets you in.
You have freed Thelin, so the Torment portal lets you in.
You have agreed to help Fahlia Shadyglade free Tylis.

actions.detail: Kill the Keeper of Sorrows.

steps.title: Combine the four essences into the Quintessence

requires.why: Grand Librarian Maelin has told you to gather the four elemental essences to power Meldrath's time machine.

actions.detail: Put the Mound of Living Stone, Globe of Dancing Flame, Sphere of Coalesced Water and Amorphous Cloud of Air in an Odylic Vial. Click combine to make the Quintessence of Elements.

steps.credit: Only the person who combines.
steps.message: The Quintessence of Elements is created. This combine never fails and needs no skill.
debug: Check that all four essences are inside the vial.
The essences cannot be traded. One person must collect all four.
steps.notes: The Odylic Vial is a four-slot container made with pottery. You need two High Quality Firing Sheets, an Unfired Medium Container and a Multielement Glaze. This guide could not confirm where you fire it. The essences and the Quintessence are no-trade, but they stay when you log out.
steps.why: The Quintessence of Elements powers Meldrath's time machine. It is your ticket into the Plane of Time.

steps.title: Activate Meldrath's time machine

requires.why: Grand Librarian Maelin has told you to gather the four elemental essences to power Meldrath's time machine.
You hold the Quintessence of Elements. Muon only notices it in your main inventory or bags, not your bank.

actions.detail: Optional: hail Grand Librarian Maelin in the Plane of Knowledge. He points you to Chronographer Muon. He does not give the flag.
Hail Chronographer Muon in the Plane of Innovation. Carry the Quintessence in your bags.
Say "yes" to Muon. He moves you to the time-projection chamber, and Loreseeker Maelin appears there.
Click the time machine. You get the flag and land in the Plane of Time.

npcs.name: Chronographer Muon
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Innovation.

npcs.name: Loreseeker Maelin
npcs.notes: Appears in the time-projection chamber when Muon sends you there. He only chats and leaves after 15 minutes.

npcs.name: The time machine
npcs.notes: In the time-projection chamber in the Plane of Innovation.

npcs.name: Grand Librarian Maelin
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Knowledge.

steps.credit: Only the person who clicks the machine. That person also gets permission to enter both parts of the Plane of Time.
steps.message: "You have received a character flag!" then "The ages begin to tear through your body. You wake to find yourself in another time."
debug: If Muon says "Greeting acknowledged.  I have no use for you at this time.  Good bye.", move the Quintessence from your bank to your bags.
That same reply also means Maelin has not told you about the essences yet.
The machine does nothing at all without Maelin's plan and the Quintessence.
steps.notes: The Quintessence is not used up. Seer Mal Nae`Shi's guided meditation confirms it: "Your soul has formed a bond with the Plane of Time." Some in-game hints say to return to Maelin, but the flag comes from the machine.
steps.why: The time machine in the Plane of Innovation gives you your Plane of Time flag. It also gives you permission to enter both parts of the Plane of Time.

steps.title: Hail the projection after the Mystical Arbitor

requires.why: Grand Librarian Maelin has told you to gather the four elemental essences to power Meldrath's time machine.
You do not already have the key to the deeper Plane of Earth.

actions.detail: In the Plane of Earth, complete the four ring events: Stone, Mud, Vine and Dust. All four must be done within 24 hours of each other.
Kill A Mystical Arbitor of Earth when it appears. It drops its hate and switches targets at random about every 20 seconds.
Hail the Planar Projection that appears where the Arbitor died.

npcs.name: Ring event controller
npcs.notes: Tracks the four ring events in the Plane of Earth.

npcs.name: A Mystical Arbitor of Earth
npcs.notes: Appears after all four rings are done. It leaves after 50 minutes.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.notes: Appears where the Arbitor died. It stays 20 minutes. Its timer pauses during combat. It gives at most 54 keys.

steps.credit: Everyone in the killer's raid who hails the projection. Without a raid, the killer's group. Otherwise only the killer.
steps.message: "Your will must be strong <name>. Seek council with the council of twelve if you so wish." then "You have received a character flag!"
debug: Be in the same raid or group as the player who got credit for the Arbitor kill.
If the Arbitor never appeared, a ring was older than 24 hours when the last one finished. Redo the old ring.
The projection says nothing if you already have the key.
The projection stops after 54 keys or 20 minutes. Hail it right away.
steps.why: This gives you the key to the deeper Plane of Earth. There you fight the Rathe Council and the Avatar of Earth.

steps.title: Enter the deeper Plane of Earth

requires.why: You earned the key from the planar projection after the Mystical Arbitor.

actions.detail: In the Plane of Earth, click one of the three doors to the deeper Plane of Earth. Two of them are near the Arbitor's area.

npcs.name: Door to the deeper Plane of Earth
npcs.notes: Near the Mystical Arbitor's area in the Plane of Earth.

npcs.name: Door to the deeper Plane of Earth
npcs.notes: Next to the other door near the Mystical Arbitor's area.

npcs.name: Door to the deeper Plane of Earth
npcs.notes: Elsewhere in the Plane of Earth.

steps.credit: Only the person who clicks the door.
steps.message: You are moved into the deeper Plane of Earth. There is no message.
debug: Without the key, the door silently does nothing.
The raid access rule does not apply here. Every player needs their own key.
You must be level 46 or higher.
Seer Mal Nae`Shi's meditation does not mention this key, so it cannot confirm it for you.
steps.why: The Arbitor's key lets you through the doors to the deeper Plane of Earth. Its first use gives you permission to enter that zone.

steps.title: Enter the Plane of Time from Tranquility

requires.why: You activated Meldrath's time machine in the Plane of Innovation.
Permission to enter the Plane of Time only comes from that time machine.

actions.detail: Click the Plane of Time portal in the Plane of Tranquility.
In the Plane of Time, click one of the five dials to enter the second part of the plane.

npcs.name: Plane of Time portal
npcs.notes: In the Plane of Tranquility. It leads to the Plane of Time.

steps.credit: Only the person who clicks.
steps.message: "The ages begin to tear through your body. You wake to find yourself in another time."
debug: You must be level 64 to enter. Below level 65 the portal may say "You lack the will to pass through this portal safely." even when it still lets you through.
The dials need level 65. Otherwise you see "You lack the will to pass through this portal safely."
The dials need a raid of at least 7 players. Otherwise you see "You don't have sufficient power to affect things in the Plane of Time."
In a guild instance outside your guild's raid window you see "The flow of time is too stable for this portal to open."
"Your fate is bound to another guild's thread of time." means you are saved to another guild's timeline.
"Your fate is already bound to another thread of time." means you are saved to another instance that has not expired.
"The energy has been drained from this portal." means the trial is full. Each dial takes 18 players, 90 in total.
steps.notes: On servers with raid access turned on, you may get in without permission if at least 85% of your raid already has it.
steps.why: Once the time machine has flagged you, the portal in the Plane of Tranquility takes you to the Plane of Time. The dials there lead to the second part.
